parameters.name: Hosts
parameters.description: The domain names of the one or more hosts that are exposed by the ASM gateway. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

parameters.name: IstioGatewayName
parameters.description: The name of the ASM gateway.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of Istio gateways to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh delete-istio-gateway-domains --service-mesh-id c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --istio-gateway-name ingressgateway --hosts example.com,demo.com --port-name https --namespace default --limit 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh DeleteIstioGatewayDomains --region cn-hangzhou --Hosts 'example.com,demo.com' --ServiceMeshId c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --Limit 10 --PortName https --Namespace default --IstioGatewayName ingressgateway
